subject: Microgrant request: CloudSpark accelerator promo credits

From: Lara Mendes <liaison@cloudspark.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: microgrant promo credits for CloudSpark Accelerator cohort

Hi Karthik,

Hope you’re well — we’re kicking off our next CloudSpark accelerator cohort (starts Aug 3) and want to offer participants a small 'microgrant' of Redwood credits so they can prototype quickly in week 1. Historically we ask partners for 10k token-equivalent per team and cap to active use over 60 days.

Can Redwood provide a partner-sourced promo credit allocation for up to 5 teams (total ~50k token-equivalent)? We’re trying to finalize the onboarding pack by Friday.

Attached is our standard cohort MAA and a short one-pager on expected usage. Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Best,
Lara
CloudSpark Accelerator Program Lead
[attachment: CloudSpark_MAA_signed.pdf (PDF)]

Subject: Re: Request: microgrant promo credits for CloudSpark Accelerator cohort

Thanks Lara — congrats on the upcoming cohort. Quick clarifying questions so we can route this internally:

- Confirm total credit amount requested (you wrote ~50k token-equivalent; is that flexible?)
- Are credits for hosted Redwood API only, or will participants use Dedicated/private entitlements?
- Do you need usage reporting (weekly) or just a single cap and expiry?

Looping in Vanessa (partnerships) and Hannah (finance) to review. If you can send the onboarding doc link, that helps us scope expected token profile.

Cheers,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: microgrant promo credits for CloudSpark Accelerator cohort

Thanks Karthik — I spoke with Lara this morning. Recommendation: approve a 10k token-equivalent microgrant per team for up to 5 teams (total 50k) with a 60-day expiry from issuance. Conditions:

- Credits only for hosted Redwood API (no Dedicated/on-prem usage).
- Reporting: partner to provide a simple weekly usage snapshot (CSV) for the duration.
- Marketing: CloudSpark agrees to include Redwood logo in cohort materials (one-line blurb).

I attached the MAA Lara sent with our redlines flagged. If finance is okay with the exposure, I’m happy to sign off and push final credit codes.

[attachment: promo-credit-guidelines.md (Markdown, 2 pages)]

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
